curation.notes: LUMICKS C-Trap force-clamp assays of tension-dependent DNA cleavage by human ANKLE1 endonuclease on three tethered substrates (15 kb four-way junction, 15 kb bubble, 48.5 kb lambda-DNA) in a dual-trap dumbbell; additional quadruple-trap experiments braided two lambda-DNA molecules into a single catenane held at ~40 pN. Cleavage times analysed with Bell-Evans and a combined Michaelis-Menten/Bell-Evans model; bulk gel cleavage assays are complementary.

evidence.snippet: is the absolute temperature (taken to be 298 K for these experiments)
The optical trap stiffness used in these experiments was 0.2–0.3 pN/nm.

assay.bead_geometry: two_bead_dumbbell (dual trap); two dumbbells braided (quadruple trap)

evidence.snippet: 0.005% w/v streptavidin-coated polystyrene beads (∼4.4 µm, Spherotech) in TN50 Buffer in channel 1

handle_sequences.annotations: The custom 15 kb bubble construct consisted of two 7.5 kb dsDNA handles and a centrally located constitutive ‘bubble’, i.e., a permanent, unpaired region of 24 nt.

evidence.snippet: Wild-type ANKLE1 (hANKLE331–615 R492H) was expressed and purified as previously described [29].

entities.name: 15 kb dsDNA with central four-way junction

evidence.snippet: The custom 15 kb dsDNA construct containing a centrally located four-way junction was prepared as previously described [40].
The custom 15 kb bubble construct consisted of two 7.5 kb dsDNA handles and a centrally located constitutive ‘bubble’, i.e., a permanent, unpaired region of 24 nt.
The 48.5 kb λ-DNA was prepared as previously described [44].

entities.name: 7.5 kb dsDNA handles (PCR from lambda-phage DNA)

evidence.snippet: Briefly, a 7.5 kb handle was prepared using PCR with Pfu Ultra II Fusion HS polymerase (Agilent) from a λ-phage genomic DNA template

source.snippet: At high tension, we observe that the rate at which ANKLE1 catalyzes the cleavage of DNA junctions increases continuously with applied tension, with a 20-fold increase in the cleavage rate at 60 pN.
